acceptance.name: candidate-continuity
acceptance.statement: The public candidate, GitLab checkout, tested artifact and returned provenance name the same full revision; all changed paths stay inside this contract.

acceptance.name: source-regressions
acceptance.statement: The declared regression suites pass with retained logs and zero skipped required cases; reproduce and retain any new failure before a bounded repair.

acceptance.name: native-browser-recovery
acceptance.statement: Run the declared native profiles and rendered voice/assistant/workflow recovery checks, including cancellation, stale readback, permission loss, retained drafts and independent accounts.

acceptance.name: external-readback
acceptance.statement: After the separately authorized release, an independent observer records the deployed revision and actual Buddi/workspace behavior for the same candidate; missing provider or post-call evidence remains HOLD.

objective: Independently exercise the repaired Buddi and workspace connection recovery paths, repair reproduced public-source defects, and retain candidate-bound browser, native and release readback.
